import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data

# Set style

sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Top 10 dog breeds by count
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, breed_counts.values)):
    ax1.text(count + count*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{count:,}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog distribution by district
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(district_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(district_counts.values, labels=district_counts.index, 
                                   colors=colors, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                   textprops={'fontsize': 8})
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontsize(8)

# 3. Dog age distribution

bars = ax3.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values)
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Dog Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Dog Age Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, age_counts.values)):
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + bar.get_height()*0.01,
             f'{count:,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8, rotation=0)

# 4. Dog gender distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']

                                   colors=colors, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Owner age distribution
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
owner_age_order = df['AlterV10Lang'].dropna().unique()

bars = ax5.bar(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.values, color='#6A0572')
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(owner_age_counts)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(owner_age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Owners', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Dog Owner Age Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, owner_age_counts.values)):
    ax5.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + bar.get_height()*0.01,
